title: MIDI NFT DOA Procedural for lofi defi hip hop
tagline: A collaborative way to generate lofi beats or chiptune music using NFTs and governance tokens
description:
Music is about experimentation and technique. NFTs are immutable forms of data that live on the blockchain. By introducing musicians to immutable musical data, the musician will experiment and develop their technique. Over time, the musician will develop a ‘groove’ for the music, which is when the music is ‘good’ and everyone enjoys it.

With MIDI minting NFT DOA Procedural for lofi defi hip hop---
Users create small nfts that store MIDI data (on-chain and off), and allow an ad-hoc DOA remix each small MIDI nft to create a larger song, and eventually a playlist/radio
Every MIDI track that is remixed is voted based on the MIDI nfts they contribute, until a super-majority “yes” vote is cast
Every song created is upvoted based on a governance token system
The governance tokens are minted by burning unused/underutilized songs and MIDI samples
how_its_made: forked of https://github.com/iainnash/zora-essay-edition-minter and edited the code to upload .mid file and abstract to blockchain. Had a hard time dealing with different file formats and tried to configure a way to convert the .mid file to a .mp3 that could be uploaded to Zora. Also tried to use NFT.storage, but unfortunately due to time constraints couldn't get the files to upload correctly
